## DECISION NEEDED — authorize a one-time operator deploy of the nginx edge (this is the only thing left)

**The code is done.** The parity fix merged as `25fd2cf6dd75` (Gerrit change 2348); AC1-AC4 pass and their tests are green. AC5 (live validation) is the sole failure, and it fails for one reason: the edge was never redeployed, so the running `rebar.conf` still serves the pre-fix `http://` Location downgrade.

**Why nothing will fix this automatically — it is by design.** Per closed bug `1d1b-a719` (downy-feminist-leopard) and **ADR 0079** (autodeploy-on-box-timer), autodeploy is DETECT-AND-SIGNAL ONLY for config/nginx: it emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=config_manual` on an edge delta but never renders/reloads `rebar.conf`. Unattended config auto-apply was deliberately deferred to v2 (idea epic `6d60-2d0c`), specifically because this box also hosts a live fail-closed Gerrit submit gate. So this merged change stays non-live indefinitely until a human applies it.

**How comparable OSS handles this:** Argo CD keeps drift *detection* always-on but *auto-sync* opt-in; Terraform separates `plan` from `apply`. Both require an explicit human apply for high-blast-radius infra — exactly the posture ADR 0079 chose here.

**Recommendation:** Authorize a one-time operator deploy on box `i-00880b2c7f13527c5`: render `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` + `nginx -t` + reload, and recreate `review-bot`/`opcert` with `FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS` set (the root-cause layer). Then re-run the AC5 probes (`curl -sSD- https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/review/health/` etc.) and close with the already-recorded attribution. Until then a61d is **code-complete, deploy-pending**, not failed. (Note: the `in_progress` claim is held by a now-idle claude-code session; reclaim before validating.)
